ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with dominant high-intensity pixels (white) covering approximately 85% of the visible surface and low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) concentrated at the margins and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region. Low-intensity dark pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and a significant, vertically elongated irregular patch at the peduncle insertion. Multiple discrete, low-intensity circular spots are mapped on the mid-right lobe and inner-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, U-shaped median notch with a pixel-depth of approximately 10-12% relative to the maximum vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge. Distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular peaks and troughs, partially obscured or extended by attached organic matter.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrically convex curves originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips, terminating in distinct lateral tapers.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of roughly circular, low-intensity pixel groups; approximately 6 distinct spots on the right lobe and 3 on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark, filamentous high-contrast masses (likely macroalgae) attached to both the left and right distal tips, disrupting the clean geometric edge of the fluke.
